summary: Slice 3 of revision 2. BranchMenu now renders through the approved SidePane adapter (title and named close control "Switch branch"), keeping its filter box focus, local/remote sections, per-branch buttons, loading text and Escape close, with the pane-filling CSS in Git.module.css so long names wrap. UpdateDialog already builds on the shared Dialog, so it is now a side pane; tests prove the pane, the named close running onClose, unchanged content/actions, and no close path while downloading/installing. package.json and package-lock.json already record jattac.libs.web.zest-responsive-layout ^2.8.0 / 2.8.0 and the package injects its own CSS; a test now reads both files to prove A2. npm run lint, npm run build and the full window suite (547 tests) pass.
